tickets.title: Prepare liquidity planning analysis
tickets.text: Review expected cash needs, emergency reserve targets, recurring income sources, upcoming distributions, and potential funding sources. Summarize recommended cash cushion, any portfolio trades needed to raise cash, tax considerations, and questions for the lead advisor before discussion with Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp. Calculate the cash shortfall for Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp, which is caused by $24,000 wedding costs, $1,850 monthly apartment rent through May 2024, and a $9,600 monthly spending estimate.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-18 is to address the cash reserve and remaining lease impact.
